lines: With no escape, Juubei was sure to be filled full of holes.
A symbol that looked like a third eye appeared on his forehead as well.
They all passed right through Juubei's body.
「That sorta stuff's not gonna hit me, ya know? Might as well stop. It's a waste of bullets.」
He was standing there with a composed expression.
Being a chakram made of an ultrahard metal, it would cut even diamond easily, and whirled through the air at her command.
However, even that deadly chakram simply passed through Juubei's body.
「I toldja they weren't gonna hit. You're a girl who doesn't listen, eh?」
He said, with an exasperated face.
The power to control metal at will.
That was the reason why, no matter how much they attacked him with metallic bullets and chakrams, they passed straight through his body.
However, it looked like Juubei was in no mood to fight with Siren, so he completely ignored the bullets and the chakram, and looked at Kaworu.
The other two also stood up, as if to say that the meeting was over now.
「You reprobates!!! Do you have no code of honour?!」
That moment, the chakram, which had still been flying, fell to the floor, making a clanking sound.
That wasn't something that she had done. It had been knocked down so quickly that she didn't realize that.
By the time it suddenly registered, the tip of the sneering Phantom Witch's blade was pointed at Siren's throat.
「The underworld has its own rules. It's unseemly to make a racket.」
「Go on, now. Let's meet again someday, Gangster-kun.」
The Phantom Witch smiled at Juubei's wisecrack, which was putting his life on the line, when at that time,
「It's one spot of trouble after another, eh?」
「Didn't you have a storeroom below us where you've collected valuable goods? Hadn't you better go there?」
Siren spat out, then hurriedly disappeared into the basement, taking her men with her.
「The meeting is adjourned, I see. Later.」
The Phantom Witch also left, as if she had known this was going to happen from the beginning.
「Well, shall we try headin' back too? Mmm? Your face is kinda scary, Yuri.」
Juubei noticed Yuri's slightly displeased-looking face.
「You were a Taimanin, and an Evil Eye user at that, weren't you?」
Her voice hardened due to him playing dumb.
「You didn't need anything like a bodyguard. Why did you help me?」
「You're askin' that?! Man you're a hopeless woman.」
「Eh? Me?! Are you saying you put your life on the line to hit on me?!」
「I always risk my life for a beautiful woman.」
She turned her face away in a huff.
「More importantly, Yuri, why don't you ask about the Demonologist you're lookin' for?」
Due to signs that he had struck out, he forcibly changed the subject and pointed at Kaworu.
Kaworu, who had been smirking as she watched the pair's exchange, widened her eyes in surprise.
「Hey! Did you use me as bait for picking her up?」
「I'll buy ya a drink, so please, Boss!」
She made a frosty expression due to Juubei, who put his palms together and bowed his head.
「I decline. You must be tired of being led around by a man like this. I'll buy you a drink.」
Kaworu and Yuri set off walking at a brisk pace.
Even as Juubei called out to them, he was completely ignored.
The Gangster, Kanzaki Juubei, chased after the two of them with a rather pathetic face.
